title: The response field approach to path integral control
abstract: arXiv:2611.30044v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper investigates non-linear path integral control problems within the response field formalism of nonequilibrium field theory. The aim of this work is exploratory, based on the identification of correspondences between backward adjoint processes and the response field of non-equilibrium statistical physics, whose properties have not been set out in an optimal control setting. The response field is found to play an analogous role to the backward adjoint process under the stochastic maximum principle. In particular, the gradient of the optimal cost-to-go at the initial time, which is proportional to the optimal control, is given by the average of the response field at the initial time. In contrast to the case of non-equilibrium dynamics, the response function is found to be acausal in the control setting. translated_title: 路径积分控制的响应场方法
translated_abstract: 本文在非平衡场论的响应场形式体系框架下研究非线性路径积分控制问题。这项工作具有探索性，其基础是建立后向伴随过程与非平衡统计物理中响应场之间的对应关系，而这些性质此前尚未在最优控制的背景下被系统阐述。研究发现，响应场在随机最大值原理下扮演着与后向伴随过程类似的角色。特别地，最优代价函数在初始时刻的梯度（与最优控制成正比）由初始时刻响应场的平均值给出。与非平衡动力学的情形不同，在控制背景下响应函数被发现是非因果的。本文进一步研究了路径积分控制的线性二次型情形，证实其相当于自由理论，即求解该控制问题……
tldr: 该论文开创性地将非平衡统计物理中的响应场形式体系引入路径积分最优控制，建立了响应场与随机最大值原理中后向伴随过程的对应关系，并证明最优控制由初始时刻响应场的平均值给出。
en_tdlr: This paper pioneers the application of the response field formalism from nonequilibrium statistical physics to path integral optimal control, establishing a correspondence between the response field and the backward adjoint process of the stochastic maximum principle, and showing that the optimal control is given by the average of the response field at the initial time.
